summary: Pharming Group N.V. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 29, 2026, announcing an abrupt CEO transition. The Board and CEO Fabrice Chouraqui mutually agreed he would step down as CEO and Executive Director with immediate effect, citing insufficient alignment on executing the company's next-phase strategic priorities. The Board appointed Chief Commercial Officer Leverne Marsh and CFO Kenneth Lynard as Interim Co-CEOs, splitting patient-focused operations from global corporate functions, and commenced a formal search for a permanent successor. No financial terms, advisors, or severance details were disclosed. Watch for permanent CEO selection, any strategic-priority shift, and pipeline execution risk.
